title: Spurious Wakeup Wait Loop Failure
pattern: Waiting on a condition variable or monitor inside an `if` block instead of a `while` loop.
why_bad: Vulnerable to spurious wakeups. The thread can be awakened by the OS or scheduler even when the condition is not met, violating safety invariants.
detection: An `if` statement wrapping a condition variable `wait` or `await`.
counterexample: None. Waiting on a condition variable must always be in a loop.
source: Maurice Herlihy, *Monitors and Blocking Synchronization*, Chapter 8.
